# Valux UI

> Accessible React components for modern Next.js applications with a
> native-mobile feel: Button, Card, Menu, Popover, Tooltip, Dialog, Sheet,
> Toast, Input, TextArea, Switch, Checkbox, Radio, Select, ContextMenu,
> Drawer, and SwiftUI-style Hero view transitions between pages. One theme, ONE pronounced radius, one motion signature (panels
> morph out of their triggers). Zero runtime dependencies, TypeScript,
> ESM + CJS. Install: `pnpm add @valux/ui`.

Key conventions: dialogs dismiss ONLY via the built-in X (never add Cancel
buttons); there is no radius prop anywhere; Sheet is a separate component,
not a Dialog variant; toasts queue one at a time behind a single Toaster.

## Docs

- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): install, root setup, first components, kit conventions
- [ValuxProvider](docs/components/provider.md): theme (mode, primary color, density, font), nesting
- [Button](docs/components/button.md): colors, variants, sizes, icons, loading, asChild
- [Card](docs/components/card.md): composable surface, variants (outline/elevated/soft), Media/Header/Title/Subtitle/Body/Footer
- [Menu](docs/components/menu.md): trigger morph, items, shortcuts, destructive items
- [Popover](docs/components/popover.md): non-modal anchored panel
- [Tooltip](docs/components/tooltip.md): delay/warm groups, rich content, placements
- [Dialog](docs/components/dialog.md): sizes, placement, Header/Body/Footer, Icon, alert, nesting
- [Sheet](docs/components/sheet.md): floating bottom sheet, detents, expandable, pull to close
- [Drawer](docs/components/drawer.md): floating side panel, left/right, sizes, pull sideways to close
- [Toast](docs/components/toast.md): toast(), queueing rules, toast.promise, positions
- [Input & TextArea](docs/components/input.md): curated types, variants, sizes, validation, counter
- [Switch](docs/components/switch.md): native-feel toggle, drag to commit, sizes, settings rows
- [Checkbox & Radio](docs/components/checkbox.md): drawn checkmark, indeterminate, RadioGroup with popping dot
- [Select](docs/components/select.md): Input-look trigger, morphing listbox panel, combobox filter, keyboard
- [Context menu](docs/components/context-menu.md): right-click / long-press Menu at the pointer
- [View transitions](docs/components/view-transitions.md): Hero shared elements between pages, presets, same-page morphs
- [Motion](docs/motion.md): the morph signature, gestures, reduced motion
